question: Find the value of (sin 30⁰ + cos 30⁰)/(cos 30⁰ - sin 30⁰).
solution:

sin30° = 1/2 and cos30° = √3/2

**Calculation:**

We have to find the value of (sin 30⁰ + cos 30⁰)/(cos 30⁰ - sin 30⁰)

On putting the value of sin30° and cos30° we get

⇒ (frac{1)/(2) + (√3)/(2)}{(√3)/(2) - (1)/(2)}
